services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Fox Venues is the one-stop shop for event space in the Silicon Valley. We own, manage and/or book three rental venues in total. Our Silicon Valley venues are centrally located between San Francisco and San Jose. Fox venues range in capacity from 200 to over 8,000 and cover a wide range of budgets. We specialize in private events of all kinds including cocktail parties & receptions, corporate events, sit-down dinners, auctions, fundraisers, galas, seminars, conferences, wedding receptions, birthday parties, and family celebrations.
